Levi Skye Morris

Engineer, leader, and photographer in Boulder County, Colorado.

Lion beneath the crater rim

I spent six years as a CTO building payment and compliance systems that had to stay up through almost anything, and the years before that building healthcare, e-commerce, and booking platforms.

Now I help mission-driven teams in conservation, climate, disaster resilience, health, and impact work build reliable systems and healthy engineering organizations a few days a week. The rest of my time goes to the mountains, my garden, playing bass guitar and French horn, and rides with the Boulder Mountain Bike Patrol.

If your team could use a hand, email me.
